newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AGL, Westralian Sands sign gas deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AGL, Westralian Sands sign gas deal.

text.p: The Australian Gas Light Co said on Friday that it has agreed to supply gas to a new lime plant being built by a subsidiary of Westralian Sands Ltd.
AGL will supply gas and build, own and operate a pipeline lateral supplying the plant, being built by Westralian unit Westlime (WA) Ltd, near Dongara, Western Australia (WA).

The gas will be sourced from a producer in the Carnarvon Basin region, transported through the Dampier to Bunbury gas pipeline and a new 16 km, 100 mm pipeline lateral constructed to deliver gas to the Westlime site, AGL said.
The start of gas deliveries will coincide with the startup of operations at Westlime, scheduled for early 1997.
"This is a very important step for AGL," said Bruce Beeren, group general manager energy trading and transmission.
"For the first time AGL will be wholesaling gas in the Western Australian market and for the first time building and owning WA pipeline infrastructure," he said in a statement.
AGL, operator of Western Australia's Goldfields Gas Transmission Pipeline and Pilbara Energy Pipeline, which total 1,600 km, has said it wants a bigger presence in the state.
